title: Grateful Dead Live at Marin County Veterans Auditorium on 1984-03-29
lineage: Cassette  (Nakamichi DR-1) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/96k) -> Adobe Audition v3.0 -> Samplitude Professional v11.03 -> FLAC/16
source: SBD -> Cassette Master (Sony D5) -> Cassette (Sony D5/Maxell XLIIS-90)

ai_review.summary: Clean soundboard capture of a great Rex Foundation benefit show with solid performance and clear audio.
ai_review.review: Reviewers describe the concert as a GREAT show, praising the clean‑sounding mix that lets Charlie’s contribution shine through. The recording is noted as a direct soundboard feed (sbd) with generally good clarity, though one reviewer mentions a dip in quality when Micah wasn’t dialed in. The event is also recognized for its historic first‑Rex Foundation benefit status.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviewers are generally positive about the performance and recording quality, but limited comments and a zero‑star rating for one review reduce certainty.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clean, direct soundboard feed; some criticism of occasional dial‑in issues (Micah).

show_quality.setlist_flow: Benefit show with enthusiastic atmosphere; no specific set‑list commentary.
